sourceSentences.text: The Princess and the Goblin was published in 1872 by George MacDonald.
This ebook was produced for Standard Ebooks by Alex Cabal, and is based on a transcription produced in 1996 by Jo Churcher and Al Haines for Project Gutenberg and on digital scans from Google Books.
The cover page is adapted from The Fountain of Vaucluse, a painting completed in 1841 by Thomas Cole.
The cover and title pages feature the League Spartan and Sorts Mill Goudy typefaces created in 2014 and 2009 by The League of Moveable Type.
This edition was released on August 4, 2026, 2:52 p.m. and is based on revision 6505bf1.
